messages:
tara: Quick check — Ignite goes live tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Training complete but renewal pulse dropped to 5 after the demo. Want to run a lightweight prefill + short warm pool to smooth tails and capture feedback.

owen: Got it. what's the expected load shape? bursty or steady?

tara: bursty. batch ingest ~160 r/s for 18m (avg seq 260). chat baseline 6 r/s with bursts to 65 r/s.

linh: My suggested config: prefix cache TTL=20s for repeated system prompts, aggressive KV cache for chat context, batch.window_ms=35, max_batch_tokens=1400, batching.jitter=0.10. Enable streaming_fallback=true so interactive users get tokens while fallback routes if needed.

priya: can you paste the warmup command so ops can schedule? also note we should rate-limit the prefill to avoid origin overload.

tara: paste below — use pref_rate to cap the origin calls.
``` 
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RID" \ 
  -d '{"tenant":"ignite","routes":["/batch/generate","/chat"],"prefill_size":280,"prefill_rate":45}'
```

cs-ops-bot: Prefill job queued: job_id=prefill-2026-01-15-ignite-01 run_at=2001126800

linh: Observability checklist (emit these): prefill.requested, prefill.completed, cache.hit_rate, batch.window_ms, batch.p95/p99, stream.first_byte_ms, fallback.trigger_count. Add tag tenant:renewal_signal=low.

owen: Alert plan: short-window alert (5m) if p99>1200ms OR error_rate>3% -> route to quantized_small + enable per-client throttles. Include runbook link in the alert.

priya: ownership: @owen will run the prefill and monitor live, @linh will push metric emits, @tara owns the 48h pulse content and outreach.

tara: 48h pulse will be 2 quick questions + optional comment box. auto-create ticket if rating <=6 and tag priority=renewal.

cs-ops-bot: Prefill job started: job_id=prefill-2026-01-15-ignite-01 status=running

cs-ops-bot: Prefill job completed: job_id=prefill-2026-01-15-ignite-01 status=success duration=24s prefilled=276 routes=2

owen: Initial metrics: cache.hit_rate=78%, batch.p95=300ms, stream.first_byte=102ms, no fallbacks triggered. Leaving warm pool up for +18m.

linh: I'll update the Confluence runbook with exact alert queries and sample dashboard widgets (prefill success, cache hit, p95, p99).

tara: thanks team — will follow up on any negative pulse responses. closing thread unless something changes. :white_check_mark:
